build_AddSentenceToWords_enhancer: build a python module that creates an AddSentenceToWords enhancer to match and assign sentences to Word events
build_AssignSentenceSplit_enhancer: build a python module that creates an AssignSentenceSplit enhancer to split sentences into train val and test sets
build_AddContextToWords_enhancer: build a python module that creates an AddContextToWords enhancer to add preceding sentence context to each word
